Chat.description_en: Sends text or multimodal messages to initiate internet-connected conversations. Supports deep thinking, session history management, and both complete JSON and Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming responses. Specific agent and media capabilities depend on the activated scope
Chat.description_zh: 发送文本或多模态消息进行联网对话，支持深度思考、会话历史管理以及完整 JSON 响应和 SSE 流式响应。具体 Agent 及媒体能力以已开通范围为准

OpenService.description_en: Validates the service activation API or initiates service activation for the current account, and returns the current activation status along with the available order or instance ID
OpenService.description_zh: 验证服务开通接口或为当前账户发起服务开通，返回当前开通状态及可用的订单或实例编号

StreamVoice.description_en: Uploads voice data over a WebSocket connection and receives recognized text, agent responses, and synthesized audio. Supports image and text auxiliary input, recognition context, and session history. The operation description includes the complete handshake, control frames, audio frames, return events, and error handling protocols
StreamVoice.description_zh: 通过 WebSocket 上传语音并接收识别文字、Agent 回复及合成音频，支持图文辅助输入、识别上下文和会话历史。接口说明包含完整握手、控制帧、音频帧、返回事件与错误处理协议
